units.spine: The Free Elder Council governs here by agreement and by nothing else, and almost nothing it asks of the place arrives.
A traveller says the Free Elder Council heard him out and settled nothing, while a household that sits on no council at all had the matter done before dark.

units.poolKey: no token matched: unclassified (the plain-description floor)
units.spine: The affairs of the place run through the Free Elder Council, and it keeps no building, no seal and no paid hand.

units.poolKey: capture pressure ADVANCING (weak security, poor prosperity)
units.spine: Pressure to buy a hold here is advancing, and little stands in its way: no watch, no purse worth the name, and a council that is only the older heads agreeing. No criminal hold has been taken yet, and that is the part of it most worth checking again.
A decision here is talked over until everyone can live with it, and once it is made it stays made.

units.poolKey: governing body name: a SLOT, never a baked noun
units.spine: A stranger who gives the Free Elder Council any other name is corrected at once, politely and by whoever is nearest.
Warmholz is no longer certain the Free Elder Council speaks for it, and the Council governs like a body that doubts it too.

units.poolKey: legitimacyHold: public rejection is breaking the hold
units.spine: The common grazing is shared out by the households and not by the Free Elder Council, and what the Council has lost here it has lost to the place and to no rival.
